description: Daily price history for tracked PC components since late October 2026: GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, RTX 5070, Radeon RX 9070, Ryzen 5 9600X, Ryzen 7 9800X3D, and 1TB and 2TB NVMe SSDs. For each: today's floor price, 7/30/90-day change, and the lowest, highest and median price recorded, with dates. Use for 'are GPU prices going up', 'is now a good time to buy a 5070', or to tell whether a sale price (Black Friday, Prime Day) is really low or just back to an earlier normal. The floor is the cheapest in-spec new listing on Newegg's first results page each day, not every retailer; collection gaps are reported, not filled in. For one specific asking price, use price_check.

days.description: With a segment: how many days of the daily series to return. Omit for all of it.

segment.description: One component to report on, with its daily series. Omit for a summary of all of them.
